speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. Please tell me, you mentioned fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent treatment for sinusitis; could you describe exactly when these new symptoms started and their severity?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis.

I am concerned about the timing of your symptoms appearing after antibiotic treatment for sinusitis; did you perhaps have a urine culture performed before starting those antibiotics to rule out an initial urinary infection?
